080/**
081 * Represents an HTTP request for a REST resource.
082 *
083 * <p>
084 *    The {@link RestRequest} object is an extension of the <l>HttpServletRequest</l> class
085 *    with various built-in convenience methods for use in building REST interfaces.
086 *    It can be accessed by passing it as a parameter on your REST Java method:
087 * </p>
088 *
089 * <p class='bjava'>
090 *    <ja>@RestPost</ja>(...)
091 *    <jk>public</jk> Object myMethod(RestRequest <jv>req</jv>) {...}
092 * </p>
093 *
094 * <p>
095 *    The primary methods on this class are:
096 * </p>
097 * <ul class='javatree'>
098 *    <li class='jc'>{@link RestRequest}
099 *    <ul class='spaced-list'>
100 *       <li>Methods for accessing the request content:
101 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
102 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getContent() getContent()}
103 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getInputStream() getInputStream()}
104 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getReader() getReader()}
105 *       </ul>
106 *       <li>Methods for accessing HTTP parts:
107 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
108 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#checkPreconditions(RestResponse) checkPreconditions(RestResponse)}
109 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#containsFormParam(String) containsFormParam(String)}
110 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#containsHeader(String) containsHeader(String)}
111 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#containsQueryParam(String) containsQueryParam(String)}
112 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getHeader(Class) getHeader(Class)}
113 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getHeader(String) getHeader(String)}
114 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getHeaders() getHeaders()}
115 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getFormParam(Class) getFormParam(Class)}
116 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getFormParam(String) getFormParam(String)}
117 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getFormParams() getFormParams()}
118 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPathParam(Class) getPathParam(Class)}
119 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPathParam(String) getPathParam(String)}
120 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPathParams() getPathParams()}
121 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPathRemainder() getPathRemainder()}
122 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getQueryParam(Class) getQueryParam(Class)}
123 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getQueryParam(String) getQueryParam(String)}
124 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getQueryParams() getQueryParams()}
125 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getQueryString() getQueryString()}
126 *       </ul>
127 *       <li>Methods for localization:
128 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
129 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getLocale() getLocale()}
130 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getMessage(String,Object...) getMessage(String,Object...)}
131 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getMessages() getMessages()}
132 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getTimeZone() getTimeZone()}
133 *       </ul>
134 *       <li>Methods for accessing static files:
135 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
136 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getVarResolverSession() getVarResolverSession()}
137 *       </ul>
138 *       <li>Methods for assertions:
139 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
140 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertContent() assertContent()}
141 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertCharset() assertCharset()}
142 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertFormParam(String) assertFormParam(String)}
143 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertHeader(String) assertHeader(String)}
144 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertQueryParam(String) assertQueryParam(String)}
145 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#assertRequestLine() assertRequestLine()}
146 *       </ul>
147 *       <li>Other:
148 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
149 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getAttribute(String) getAttribute(String)}
150 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getAttributes() getAttributes()}
151 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getAuthorityPath() getAuthorityPath()}
152 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getMarshallingSession() getMarshallingSession()}
153 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getCharset() getCharset()}
154 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getConfig() getConfig()}
155 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getContext() getContext()}
156 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getContextPath() getContextPath()}
157 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getHttpServletRequest() getHttpServletRequest()}
158 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getMethod() getMethod()}
159 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getOpContext() getOpContext()}
160 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getOperationSwagger() getOperationSwagger()}
161 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPartParserSession() getPartParserSession()}
162 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPartSerializerSession() getPartSerializerSession()}
163 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getPathInfo() getPathInfo()}
164 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getProtocolVersion() getProtocolVersion()}
165 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getRequest(Class) getRequest(Class)}
166 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getRequestLine() getRequestLine()}
167 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getRequestURI() getRequestURI()}
168 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getRequestURL() getRequestURL()}
169 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getServletPath() getServletPath()}
170 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getSession() getSession()}
171 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getSwagger() getSwagger()}
172 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getUriContext() getUriContext()}
173 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#getUriResolver() getUriResolver()}
174 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#isDebug() isDebug()}
175 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#isDebugMarshalling() isDebugMarshalling()}
176 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#isPlainText() isPlainText()}
177 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#isUserInRole(String) isUserInRole(String)}
178 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#setAttribute(String,Object) setAttribute(String,Object)}
179 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#setCharset(Charset) setCharset(Charset)}
180 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#setException(Throwable) setException(Throwable)}
181 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestRequest#setNoTrace() setNoTrace()}
182 *       </ul>
183 *    </ul>
184 * </ul>
185 *
186 */
187@SuppressWarnings({
188   "java:S3776", // checkPreconditions() walks the chained RFC 7232 If-Match/If-Unmodified-Since/If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since steps in order; splitting would obscure the precedence rules
189   "java:S6539", // Collection.toArray() usage intentional
190   "javabugs:S2259", // Null accesses are guarded by nn() checks; Sonar's flow analysis does not track nn() as a null guard
191   "rawtypes", // Collection constructed from ClassMeta.newInstance() is untyped.
192   "resource", // Streams returned to servlet container; lifecycle managed by the container
193   "unchecked", // Type erasure requires unchecked casts in REST client operations
194   "unused" // Unused parameters in HttpServletRequest overrides and helper methods
195})
196public class RestRequest extends HttpServletRequestWrapper {
197
198   /**
199    * Request-attribute name under which the per-response Content-Security-Policy nonce is cached.
200    *
201    * <p>
202    * Set by {@link RestResponse} when an emitted CSP header contains a nonce placeholder, and read by the
203    * serialization layer (to stamp the matching {@code nonce="..."} on inline {@code <script>}/{@code <style>} tags)
204    * so the header and the markup share the same nonce.
205    */
206   public static final String CSP_NONCE_ATTR = "CspNonce";
207
208   /**
209    * Returns {@code true} if {@code method} is one of the methods the {@code content} URL-parameter body
210    * override (see {@link Rest#disableContentParam()}) is documented to apply to.
211    *
212    * <p>
213    * Package-private for direct unit-test coverage. Restricting the override to {@code PUT}/{@code POST} (its
214    * documented scope all along) keeps a plain cross-origin {@code GET} &mdash; the kind a browser will issue
215    * with no preflight and no custom header for something as simple as an <code>&lt;img src=...&gt;</code> tag
216    * &mdash; from ever having its body-carrying {@code Content-Type} gate bypassed via a query string, without
217    * touching the {@link Rest#disableContentParam()} default itself.
218    *
219    * @param method The request's HTTP method. Can be {@code null} (returns {@code false}).
220    * @return {@code true} if {@code method} is {@code PUT} or {@code POST}, case-insensitively.
221    */
222   static boolean isContentParamMethod(String method) {
223      return eqic("PUT", method) || eqic("POST", method);
224   }
225
226   /*
227    * Converts an Accept-Language value entry to a Locale.
228    */
229   @SuppressWarnings({
230      "java:S1874" // The new Locale(String,String) constructor is not deprecated on the Java 17 baseline; its replacement Locale.of(...) was only added in Java 19.
231   })
232   private static Locale toLocale(String lang) {
233      var country = "";
234      var i = lang.indexOf('-');
235      if (i > -1) {
236         country = lang.substring(i + 1).trim();
237         lang = lang.substring(0, i).trim();
238      }
239      return new Locale(lang, country);
240   }

270   /**
271    * Constructor.
272    */
273   RestRequest(RestOpContext opContext, RestSession session) {
274      super(session.getRequest());
275      this.session = session;
276      this.opContext = opContext;
277
278      inner = session.getRequest();
279      context = session.getContext();
280
281      attrs = new RequestAttributes(this);
282
283      queryParams = new RequestQueryParamList(this, session.getQueryParams(), true);
284
285      headers = new RequestHeaderList(this, queryParams, false);
286
287      content = new RequestContent(this);
288
289      if (context.isAllowContentParam() && isContentParamMethod(inner.getMethod())) {
290         var b = queryParams.get("content").asString().orElse(null);
291         if (b != null) {
292            headers.set("Content-Type", UonSerializer.DEFAULT.getResponseContentType());
293            content.mediaType(MediaType.UON).parser(UonParser.DEFAULT).content(b.getBytes(UTF8));
294         }
295      }
296
297      pathParams = new RequestPathParamList(session, this, true);
298
299      marshallingSession = opContext.getMarshallingContext().getSession();
300
301      partParserSession = new LazyPartParserSession(opContext.getPartParser());
302
303      pathParams.parser(partParserSession);
304
305      // @formatter:off
306      queryParams
307         .addDefault(opContext.getDefaultRequestQueryData().getAll())
308         .parser(partParserSession);
309
310      headers
311         .addDefault(opContext.getDefaultRequestHeaders().getAll())
312         .addDefault(context.getDefaultRequestHeaders().getAll())
313         .parser(partParserSession);
314
315      content
316         .encoders(opContext.getEncoders())
317         .parsers(opContext.getParsers())
318         .maxInput(opContext.getMaxInput());
319
320      attrs
321         .addDefault(opContext.getDefaultRequestAttributes())
322         .addDefault(context.getDefaultRequestAttributes());
323      // @formatter:on
324
325      // Body-caching wrappers are installed by the two-phase debug pipeline before this object is
326      // constructed, based on the resolved logger's level. Nothing to wrap here.
327   }

429   /**
430    * Evaluates the conditional-request headers on this request against the response's currently-set
431    * <c>ETag</c> and <c>Last-Modified</c> values.
432    *
433    * <p>
434    * Implements the precondition-evaluation order defined by
435    * <a class='doclink' href='https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7232#section-6'>RFC 7232 §6</a>:
436    * <ol>
437    *    <li><c>If-Match</c> — strong comparison; returns <c>412 Precondition Failed</c> on mismatch.
438    *    <li><c>If-Unmodified-Since</c> — only consulted when <c>If-Match</c> is absent;
439    *       returns <c>412 Precondition Failed</c> when the response's <c>Last-Modified</c> is
440    *       strictly after the supplied date.
441    *    <li><c>If-None-Match</c> — weak comparison; returns <c>304 Not Modified</c> on match
442    *       (for safe methods, per RFC 7232 §6).
443    *    <li><c>If-Modified-Since</c> — only consulted when <c>If-None-Match</c> is absent;
444    *       returns <c>304 Not Modified</c> when the response's <c>Last-Modified</c> is at-or-before
445    *       the supplied date.
446    * </ol>
447    *
448    * <h5 class='section'>Usage:</h5>
449    *
450    * <p>
451    * Set the response's <c>ETag</c> and/or <c>Last-Modified</c> <b>first</b>, then call this method.
452    * The check reads the headers currently on the response, so any value set after the call is not
453    * considered.
454    *
455    * <p class='bjava'>
456    *    <ja>@RestGet</ja>(<js>"/{id}"</js>)
457    *    <jk>public</jk> Order get(<ja>@Path</ja> <jk>long</jk> <jv>id</jv>, RestRequest <jv>req</jv>, RestResponse <jv>res</jv>) {
458    *       <jk>var</jk> <jv>order</jv> = <jv>repo</jv>.find(<jv>id</jv>);
459    *       <jv>res</jv>.eTag(<js>"\""</js> + <jv>order</jv>.version() + <js>"\""</js>).lastModified(<jv>order</jv>.updated());
460    *       <jv>req</jv>.checkPreconditions(<jv>res</jv>).ifPresent(<jv>e</jv> -&gt; { <jk>throw</jk> <jv>e</jv>; });
461    *       <jk>return</jk> <jv>order</jv>;
462    *    }
463    * </p>
464    *
465    * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
466    *    <li class='note'>Returns an {@link Optional} so the caller controls how to handle the failure
467    *       (throw inline, hand off to a logger, etc.). Both the returned <c>304</c> and <c>412</c>
468    *       failures are {@link BasicHttpException} instances, which are {@link RuntimeException}s,
469    *       so {@code ifPresent(e -&gt; { throw e; })} compiles cleanly.
470    *    <li class='note'><c>If-None-Match: *</c> matches any present <c>ETag</c>; <c>If-Match: *</c>
471    *       fails only when no <c>ETag</c> is set on the response.
472    *    <li class='note'>Per RFC 7232 §3.1, <c>If-Match</c> requires strong comparison: a weak
473    *       <c>ETag</c> on the response side never satisfies an <c>If-Match</c>.
474    *    <li class='note'>Per RFC 7232 §3.2, <c>If-None-Match</c> uses weak comparison: the weak/strong
475    *       flag is ignored when comparing tag values.
476    * </ul>
477    *
478    * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
479    *    <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#eTag(String) RestResponse.eTag(String)}
480    *    <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#lastModified(Instant) RestResponse.lastModified(Instant)}
481    * </ul>
482    *
483    * @param response The response carrying the resource's current <c>ETag</c> and/or <c>Last-Modified</c>.
484    *    Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
485    * @return Empty if all preconditions pass; otherwise an {@link Optional} holding either a
486    *    <c>304 Not Modified</c> {@link BasicHttpException} (when the request's cache copy is still
487    *    fresh) or a {@link PreconditionFailed} (when an <c>If-Match</c> / <c>If-Unmodified-Since</c>
488    *    guard failed).
489    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code response} is <jk>null</jk>.
490    */
491   public Optional<BasicHttpException> checkPreconditions(RestResponse response) {
492      reqnn("response", response);
493      var resTagStr = response.getHeader(ETag.NAME);
494      var resTag = nn(resTagStr) ? EntityTag.of(resTagStr) : null;
495      var resLastModStr = response.getHeader(LastModified.NAME);
496      var resLastMod = nn(resLastModStr) ? parseHttpDate(resLastModStr) : null;
497
498      // RFC 7232 §6 step 1: If-Match (strong comparison; 412 on failure).
499      var ifMatch = getHeaderParam(IfMatch.NAME).orElse(null);
500      if (nn(ifMatch)) {
501         if (! matchesAnyStrong(EntityTags.of(ifMatch), resTag))
502            return o(preconditionFailed(IfMatch.NAME));
503      } else {
504         // RFC 7232 §6 step 2: If-Unmodified-Since (only when If-Match absent).
505         var ius = getHeaderParam(IfUnmodifiedSince.NAME).orElse(null);
506         if (nn(ius)) {
507            var iusDate = parseHttpDate(ius);
508            if (nn(iusDate) && nn(resLastMod) && resLastMod.toInstant().isAfter(iusDate.toInstant()))
509               return o(preconditionFailed(IfUnmodifiedSince.NAME));
510         }
511      }
512
513      // RFC 7232 §6 step 3: If-None-Match (weak comparison; 304 on match for safe methods).
514      var ifNoneMatch = getHeaderParam(IfNoneMatch.NAME).orElse(null);
515      if (nn(ifNoneMatch)) {
516         if (matchesAnyWeak(EntityTags.of(ifNoneMatch), resTag))
517            return o(notModified());
518      } else {
519         // RFC 7232 §6 step 4: If-Modified-Since (only when If-None-Match absent; only for GET/HEAD).
520         if (isSafeMethod()) {
521            var ims = getHeaderParam(IfModifiedSince.NAME).orElse(null);
522            if (nn(ims)) {
523               var imsDate = parseHttpDate(ims);
524               if (nn(imsDate) && nn(resLastMod) && ! resLastMod.toInstant().isAfter(imsDate.toInstant()))
525                  return o(notModified());
526            }
527         }
528      }
529
530      return oe();
531   }
532
533   private boolean isSafeMethod() {
534      var m = getMethod();
535      return eqic("GET", m) || eqic("HEAD", m);
536   }
537
538   private static ZonedDateTime parseHttpDate(String value) {
539      try {
540         return ZonedDateTime.from(RFC_1123_DATE_TIME.parse(value)).truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.SECONDS);
541      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") DateTimeParseException e) {
542         return null;
543      }
544   }
545
546   private static boolean matchesAnyStrong(EntityTags clientTags, EntityTag resTag) {
547      if (clientTags == null)
548         return false;
549      for (var t : clientTags.toArray()) {
550         if (t.isAny())
551            return resTag != null;
552         // Strong comparison: both sides must be strong AND opaque-tag values must be equal.
553         if (! t.isWeak() && resTag != null && ! resTag.isWeak() && eq(t.getEntityValue(), resTag.getEntityValue()))
554            return true;
555      }
556      return false;
557   }
558
559   private static boolean matchesAnyWeak(EntityTags clientTags, EntityTag resTag) {
560      if (clientTags == null)
561         return false;
562      for (var t : clientTags.toArray()) {
563         if (t.isAny())
564            return resTag != null;
565         // Weak comparison: opaque-tag values must be equal; weak/strong flag is ignored.
566         if (resTag != null && eq(t.getEntityValue(), resTag.getEntityValue()))
567            return true;
568      }
569      return false;
570   }

573      return new BasicHttpException(NotModified.STATUS_CODE, NotModified.REASON_PHRASE);

661   /**
662    * Returns the URI authority portion of the request.
663    *
664    * @return The URI authority portion of the request.
665    */
666   public String getAuthorityPath() {
667      if (authorityPath == null)
668         authorityPath = context.getUriAuthority();
669      if (authorityPath == null) {
670         var scheme = inner.getScheme();
671         var port = inner.getServerPort();
672         var sb = new StringBuilder(inner.getScheme()).append("://").append(inner.getServerName());
673         if (! (port == 80 && eq(scheme, "http") || port == 443 && eq(scheme, "https")))
674            sb.append(':').append(port);
675         authorityPath = sb.toString();
676      }
677      return authorityPath;
678   }

687   /**
688    * Returns the charset specified on the <c>Content-Type</c> header, or <js>"UTF-8"</js> if not specified.
689    *
690    * @return The charset to use to decode the request content.
691    */
692   public Charset getCharset() {
693      if (charset == null) {
694         // Determine charset
695         // NOTE:  Don't use super.getCharacterEncoding() because the spec is implemented inconsistently.
696         // Jetty returns the default charset instead of null if the character is not specified on the request.
697         var h = getHeaderParam("Content-Type").orElse(null);
698         if (nn(h)) {
699            var i = h.indexOf(";charset=");
700            if (i > 0)
701               charset = Charset.forName(h.substring(i + 9).trim());
702         }
703         if (charset == null)
704            charset = opContext.getDefaultCharset();
705         if (charset == null)
706            charset = StandardCharsets.UTF_8;
707      }
708      return charset;
709   }

1058   /**
1059    * Returns the preferred Locale that the client will accept content in, based on the Accept-Language header.
1060    *
1061    * <p>
1062    * If the client request doesn't provide an <c>Accept-Language</c> header, this method returns the default locale for the server.
1063    *
1064    * @return The preferred Locale that the client will accept content in.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
1065    */
1066   @Override
1067   public Locale getLocale() {
1068      var best = inner.getLocale();
1069      var h = headers.get("Accept-Language").asString().orElse(null);
1070      if (nn(h)) {
1071         var sr = StringRanges.of(h);
1072         float qValue = 0;
1073         for (var r : sr.toList()) {
1074            if (r.getQValue() > qValue) {
1075               best = toLocale(r.getName());
1076               qValue = r.getQValue();
1077            }
1078         }
1079      }
1080      return best;
1081   }

1384   /**

1393    *    (callers such as {@code Queryable} that only have a {@link Class}, not a registered {@link RequestBeanArg}).
1394    *    Resolving here throws the same {@link IllegalArgumentException} message as {@link RequestBeanArg},

1402         if (c.isInterface())

1404               RequestBeanPropertyMeta pm = rbm.getProperty(method.getName());
1405               if (nn(pm))

1407               return null;
1408            });
1409         return newRequestBean(rbm, bs, nn(setters) ? setters : RequestBeanSetters.resolve(c, rbm));
1410      } catch (Exception e) {

1415   /**
1416    * Instantiates a concrete {@link Request @Request} bean class via the resolved {@link RequestBeanSetters} and
1417    * populates it by invoking the setter matching each annotated getter.  Absent parameters (a <jk>null</jk> resolved
1418    * value) are left at their default.
1419    */
1420   private <T> T newRequestBean(RequestBeanMeta rbm, MarshallingSession bs, RequestBeanSetters setters) throws Exception {
1421      T bean = setters.newInstance();
1422      for (var pm : rbm.getProperties()) {
1423         var getter = pm.getGetter();
1424         var value = resolveRequestBeanProperty(pm, getter, bs);
1425         if (value == null)
1426            continue;
1427         setters.set(bean, getter, value);
1428      }
1429      return bean;
1430   }

1432   private Object resolveRequestBeanProperty(RequestBeanPropertyMeta pm, java.lang.reflect.Method method, MarshallingSession bs) throws Exception {
1433      HttpPartParserSession pp = pm.getParser(getPartParserSession());
1434      HttpPartSchema schema = pm.getSchema();
1435      String name = pm.getPartName();
1436      var type = bs.getClassMeta(method.getGenericReturnType());
1437      HttpPartType pt = pm.getPartType();
1438      if (pt == HttpPartType.BODY)
1439         return getContent().setSchema(schema).as(type);
1440      if (schema.getCollectionFormat() == HttpPartCollectionFormat.MULTI) {
1441         var valueType = type.isOptional() ? type.getElementType() : type;
1442         if (valueType.isMap())
1443            return resolveRequestBeanMultiMap(pt, name, schema, type);
1444         if (valueType.isCollectionOrArray())
1445            return resolveRequestBeanMultiCollection(pt, name, pp, schema, type);
1446      }
1447      var part = requestBeanPartLast(pt, name);
1448      if (part == null)
1449         return type.isOptional() ? Optional.empty() : null;
1450      return part.parser(pp).schema(schema).def(schema.getDefault()).as(type).orElse(null);
1451   }
1452
1453   private Object resolveRequestBeanMultiMap(HttpPartType pt, String name, HttpPartSchema schema, ClassMeta<?> type) {
1454      try {
1455         var parts = requestBeanParts(pt, name);
1456         var optional = type.isOptional();
1457         if (parts.isEmpty()) {
1458            if (optional) {
1459               if (ine(schema.getDefault()))
1460                  return Optional.of(UonUtils.mergePairs(schema.getDefault()));
1461               return Optional.empty();
1462            }
1463            return JsonMap.create();
1464         }
1465         var dest = JsonMap.create();
1466         for (var p : parts)
1467            UonUtils.mergePair(dest, p.getValue());
1468         return optional ? o(dest) : dest;
1469      } catch (ParseException | SchemaValidationException e) {
1470         throw new BadRequest(e, "Could not parse query parameter '%s'.", name);
1471      }
1472   }
1473
1474   private Object resolveRequestBeanMultiCollection(HttpPartType pt, String name, HttpPartParserSession pp, HttpPartSchema schema, ClassMeta<?> type) throws Exception {
1475      var optional = type.isOptional();
1476      var raw = optional ? type.getElementType() : type;
1477      var elemType = raw.getElementType();
1478      var parts = requestBeanParts(pt, name);
1479      if (parts.isEmpty()) {
1480         if (optional) {
1481            if (ine(schema.getDefault()))
1482               return Optional.of(readDefaultCollection(schema.getDefault(), raw, elemType, pp, schema, pt));
1483            return Optional.empty();
1484         }
1485         return emptyCollection(raw, elemType);
1486      }
1487      Collection c = newCollection(raw);
1488      for (var p : parts) {
1489         if (elemType.is(String.class)) {
1490            var v = p.getValue();
1491            c.add(v == null ? "" : v);
1492         } else {
1493            c.add(p.parser(pp).schema(schema).as(elemType).orElse(null));
1494         }
1495      }
1496      if (optional && elemType.is(String.class) && c.stream().allMatch(x -> isBlank(s(x))))
1497         return Optional.of(emptyCollection(raw, elemType));
1498      var collected = raw.isArray() ? CollectionUtils.toArray(c, elemType.inner()) : c;
1499      return optional ? o(collected) : collected;
1500   }
1501
1502   @SuppressWarnings({
1503      "java:S112" // throws Exception intentional - HttpPartParserSession.read declares Exception
1504   })
1505   private Object readDefaultCollection(String def, ClassMeta<?> raw, ClassMeta<?> elemType, HttpPartParserSession pp, HttpPartSchema schema, HttpPartType pt) throws Exception {
1506      try {
1507         var one = pp.read(pt, schema, def, elemType);
1508         var c = newCollection(raw);
1509         c.add(one);
1510         return raw.isArray() ? CollectionUtils.toArray(c, elemType.inner()) : c;
1511      } catch (ParseException | SchemaValidationException e) {
1512         throw new BadRequest(e, "Could not parse %s parameter '%s'.", pt.toString().toLowerCase(), schema.getName());
1513      }
1514   }
1515
1516   private static Collection newCollection(ClassMeta<?> raw) {
1517      if (raw.isArray())
1518         return CollectionUtils.list();
1519      if (raw.canCreateNewInstance())
1520         return (Collection)raw.newInstance();
1521      return new JsonList();
1522   }
1523
1524   private static Object emptyCollection(ClassMeta<?> raw, ClassMeta<?> elemType) {
1525      var c = newCollection(raw);
1526      return raw.isArray() ? CollectionUtils.toArray(c, elemType.inner()) : c;
1527   }

1529   private List<? extends RequestHttpPart> requestBeanParts(HttpPartType pt, String name) {
1530      return switch (pt) {
1531         case QUERY -> getQueryParams().getAll(name);
1532         case FORMDATA -> getFormParams().getAll(name);
1533         case HEADER -> getHeaders().getAll(name);
1534         case PATH -> getPathParams().getAll(name);
1535         default -> List.of();
1536      };
1537   }
1538
1539   private RequestHttpPart requestBeanPartLast(HttpPartType pt, String name) {
1540      return switch (pt) {
1541         case QUERY -> getQueryParams().getLast(name);
1542         case FORMDATA -> getFormParams().getLast(name);
1543         case HEADER -> getHeaderParam(name);
1544         case PATH -> getPathParams().getLast(name);
1545         default -> null;
1546      };
1547   }

1670    * It also gives you the capability to override the query parameters (e.g. add new query parameters to the existing
1671    * URI).
1672    *
1673    * @param includeQuery If <jk>true</jk> include the query parameters on the request.
1674    * @param addQueryParams Augment the request URI with the specified query parameters.
1675    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (no additional parameters are added).
1676    * @return A new URI.

1679      var uri = inner.getRequestURI();
1680      if (includeQuery || nn(addQueryParams)) {
1681         var sb = new StringBuilder(uri);
1682         var rq = queryParams.copy();
1683         if (nn(addQueryParams))
1684            for (var e : addQueryParams.entrySet())
1685               rq.set(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
1686         if (! rq.isEmpty())
1687            sb.append('?').append(rq.asQueryString());
1688         uri = sb.toString();
1689      }
1690      try {
1691         return new URI(uri);
1692      } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
1693         // Shouldn't happen.
1694         throw toRex(e);
1695      }

1748    *    }

1751    * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
1752    *    <li class='note'>

1757    *    <li class='jm'>{@link RestContext#getVarResolver()}

1759    * </ul>

2114   /**

2118    * Merges (in order of increasing priority):
2119    * <ol>
2120    *    <li>Request attributes (from {@link #getAttributes()}, e.g. {@code defaultRequestAttributes})
2121    *    <li>UON-encoded {@code juneauSerializerOptions} query parameter
2122    *    <li>JSON5-encoded {@code X-Juneau-Serializer-Options} header
2123    *    <li>Programmatically-set properties via {@link #setSerializerSessionProperty}
2124    * </ol>
2125    *
2126    * <p>
2127    * Client-supplied keys are validated against the allowlist from {@link RestOpContext#getAllowedSerializerOptions()}.
2128    * Keys not in the allowlist cause a {@code 400 Bad Request} response.
2129    *
2130    * @return An unmodifiable map of session properties; may be empty but never {@code null}.
2131    */
2132   public Map<String,Object> getSerializerSessionPropertyMap() {
2133      var allowlist = opContext.getAllowedSerializerOptions();
2134      Map<String,Object> m1 = null;
2135      Map<String,Object> m2 = null;
2136
2137      var q = getQueryParams().get(QUERY_juneauSerializerOptions).asString().orElse(null);
2138      if (inb(q)) {
2139         m1 = parseUonMap(q, e -> badRequest(e, "Could not parse UON session options from query parameter '%s'.", QUERY_juneauSerializerOptions));
2140         var invalid = m1.keySet().stream().filter(k -> !allowlist.contains(k)).collect(Collectors.joining(","));
2141         if (!invalid.isEmpty())
2142            badRequest("Invalid session options in query parameter '%s': '%s'", QUERY_juneauSerializerOptions, invalid);
2143      }
2144
2145      var h = getHeaderParam(HEADER_JuneauSerializerOptions).asString().orElse(null);
2146      if (inb(h)) {
2147         m2 = parseJsonMap(h, e -> badRequest(e, "Could not parse JSON5 session options from header '%s'.", HEADER_JuneauSerializerOptions));
2148         var invalid = m2.keySet().stream().filter(k -> !allowlist.contains(k)).collect(Collectors.joining(","));
2149         if (!invalid.isEmpty())
2150            badRequest("Invalid session options in header '%s': '%s'", HEADER_JuneauSerializerOptions, invalid);
2151      }
2152
2153      return mergeSessionMaps(getAttributes().asMap(), m1, m2, serializerSessionProperties);
2154   }
